'''Attack Formation Beta-Zero''' was a [[Starfighter/Legends|starfighter]] tactic used by the the [[Royal Naboo Security Forces/Legends|Royal Naboo Security Force]] [[Naboo Royal Space Fighter Corps/Legends|Starfighter Corps]].
